body: Interesting na may two different preparedness horizons dito: one month for the ordinary consumable, around seven days for emergency toilet capability. That suggests a better household design than one giant ‘disaster box’: rolling inventory for things you constantly use, dedicated kit only for functions normal infrastructure may lose. Mas worth investigating next ang which other government-recommended items fit that same rolling-stock model, because that reduces expiry, clutter and forgotten supplies.

claims.text: Separating rolling everyday inventory from dedicated emergency-function supplies may reduce waste and forgotten stock.
claims.basis: Inference from the article's two official preparedness horizons and rolling-stock guidance
